```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
senic <- read.csv("SENIC-P1.csv")
set.seed(36473)
idx <- sample(nrow(senic), 85)
mydata <- senic[sort(idx), ]
holdout <- senic[-idx, ]

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```


# II

```{r}
infection.model <- lm(length ~ infection, data = mydata)
census.model <- lm(length ~ census, data = mydata)
xray.model <- lm(length ~ xray, data = mydata)
facility.model <- lm(length ~ facility, data = mydata)
```

Note: Probably a much better way to do this so if you can clean it up feel free to change the code
```{r}
means <- c(mean(mydata$length), mean(mydata$infection), mean(mydata$census),
```

# III

### Intercept and Slope of Models

```{r}
b0.infection <- coef(infection.model)[1]
b1.infection <- coef(infection.model)[2]
b0.census <- coef(census.model)[1]
b1.census <- coef(census.model)[2]
b0.xray <- coef(xray.model)[1]
b1.xray <- coef(xray.model)[2]
b0.facility <- coef(facility.model)[1]
b1.facility <- coef(facility.model)[2]
b0.infection
b1.infection
b0.census
b1.census
b0.xray
b1.xray
b0.facility
b1.facility
```

### MSE and R^2

```{r}
MSE.infection <- mean(infection.model$residuals^2)
MSE.infection
MSE.census <- mean(census.model$residuals^2)
MSE.census
MSE.xray <- mean(xray.model$residuals^2)
MSE.xray
MSE.facility <- mean(facility.model$residuals^2)
MSE.facility

infection.r.squared <- summary(infection.model)$r.squared
census.r.squared <- summary(census.model)$r.squared
xray.r.squared <- summary(xray.model)$r.squared
facility.r.squared <- summary(facility.model)$r.squared
infection.r.squared
census.r.squared
xray.r.squared
facility.r.squared


b0.list <- c(b0.infection, b0.census, b0.xray, b0.facility)
b1.list <- c(b1.infection, b1.census, b1.xray, b1.facility)
MSE.list <- c(MSE.infection, MSE.census, MSE.xray, MSE.facility)
R.squared.list <- c(infection.r.squared, census.r.squared, xray.r.squared, facility.r.squared)
model.list <- c("Length ~ Infection", "Length ~ Census", "Length ~ X-Ray", "Length ~ Facility")

model.summary <- data.frame("Model" = model.list, "b<sub>0</sub>" = b0.list, "b<sub>1</sub>" = b1.list, "MSE" = MSE.list, "$R^2$" = R.squared.list)
kable(model.summary, align = "c", caption = "Model Parameters", digits = 4, col.names = c(" ", "$\\beta_0$", "$\\beta_1$", "MSE", "$R^2$"), escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

```

### Plots with regression line

```{r panels}
yl = c(5, 25)

ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = infection, y = length)) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.infection, slope = b1.infection, lwd = 1, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Hospitals with a higher infection risk have longer stays on average", 
       x = "Infection Risk (%)", y = "Length of Stay (days)") +
  ylim(yl) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5))

ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = census, y = length)) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.census, slope = b1.census, lwd = 1, color ="firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Hospitals with more average daily patients will take longer to
       treat them resulting in longer stays",
       x = "Average Daily Census", y = "Length of Stay (days)") +
  ylim(yl) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5))

ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = xray, y = length)) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.xray, slope = b1.xray, lwd = 1, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Hospitals with more people getting chest scans with X-rays have longer stays", x = "Number of X-Ray's (per 100 people)", y = "Length of Stay (days)") +
  ylim(yl) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5))

ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = facility, y = length)) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.facility, slope = b1.facility, lwd = 1, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "The more facilities and services available the longer the say is", x = "Available Facilities (% of 35)", y = "Length of Stay (days)") +
  ylim(yl) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5))

```

```{r}
drop1 <- c("47", "112", "76", "83")
drop2 <- c("47")

infection.drop <- lm(length ~ infection, data = subset(mydata, !(id %in% drop1)))
census.drop <- lm(length ~ census, data = subset(mydata, !(id %in% drop2)))

summary(infection.model)$r.squared; summary(infection.drop)$r.squared
summary(census.model)$r.squared; summary(census.drop)$r.squared

```



```{r}
infection_outlier <- subset(mydata, id %in% drop1)
ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = infection, y = length, label = )) +

  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.census, slope = b1.census, lwd = 1, color ="firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Hospitals with more average daily patients will take longer to

            hjust = .5, vjust = 1.5, color = "red") +

```

# V

```{r}

confint(infection.model, "infection", level = 0.95)
summary(infection.model)$coefficients["infection", "t value"]
summary(infection.model)$coefficients["infection", "Pr(>|t|)"]
summary(infection.model)$df[2]
```



```{r ci-pi}
xh <- data.frame(infection = 4.4)
predict(infection.model, newdata = xh, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)
predict(infection.model, newdata = xh, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)
```



```{r wh-band}
n    <- nrow(mydata)
tval <- qt(0.975, df = n - 2)
W    <- sqrt(2 * qf(0.95, df1 = 2, df2 = n - 2))
tval
W

xh3 <- data.frame(infection = c(1.5, 3.0, 6.0))
p   <- predict(infection.model, newdata = xh3, se.fit = TRUE)   # se.fit is s{Yhat_h}

band <- data.frame(Xh       = xh3$infection,
                   Yhat     = p$fit,
                   CI_lower = p$fit - tval * p$se.fit,
                   CI_upper = p$fit + tval * p$se.fit,
                   WH_lower = p$fit - W * p$se.fit,
                   WH_upper = p$fit + W * p$se.fit)
kable(band, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Pointwise 95% CI and Working-Hotelling band", col.names = c("$X_h$", "$Y_{hat}$", "$CI_{lower}$", "$CI_{upper}$", "$WH_{lower}$", "$WH_{upper}$"), escape = FALSE)
```


### Visual Final Model Check

```{r}
top.outliers <- mydata$id[order(abs(resid(infection.model)), decreasing = TRUE)[1:4]]

outlier.index <- ifelse(mydata$id %in% top.outliers, mydata$id, " ")

plot(infection.model, which=2, id.n=4, pch = 21, col = "white", bg = "seagreen", xlab = "Theoretical Quantiles", sub.caption = "")
plot(infection.model$fitted.values, infection.model$residuals, main = "Residual against Infection Risk", ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "Infection Risk", pch = 21, bg = "seagreen", col = "white")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2)
text(infection.model$fitted.values[outlier.index], infection.model$residuals[outlier.index], outlier.index, pos = c(4, 4, 4, 4), col = "red")

```
